itinerary_items_place_state_check.name: itinerary_items_place_state_check
itinerary_items_place_state_check.value:
(
        "itinerary_items"."place_name" is null
        and "itinerary_items"."place_address" is null
        and "itinerary_items"."place_latitude" is null
        and "itinerary_items"."place_longitude" is null
        and "itinerary_items"."place_provider" is null
        and "itinerary_items"."place_provider_ref" is null
      ) or (
        "itinerary_items"."place_name" is not null
        and "itinerary_items"."place_latitude" is not null
        and "itinerary_items"."place_longitude" is not null
        and "itinerary_items"."place_provider" is not null
      )

trip_destinations_coordinates_pair_check.name: trip_destinations_coordinates_pair_check
trip_destinations_coordinates_pair_check.value: ("trip_destinations"."latitude" IS NULL AND "trip_destinations"."longitude" IS NULL) OR ("trip_destinations"."latitude" IS NOT NULL AND "trip_destinations"."longitude" IS NOT NULL)

trip_reservations_end_time_date_check.name: trip_reservations_end_time_date_check
trip_reservations_end_time_date_check.value: "trip_reservations"."end_time" is null or "trip_reservations"."end_date" is not null

trip_reservations_same_day_time_range_ch.name: trip_reservations_same_day_time_range_check
trip_reservations_same_day_time_range_ch.value: "trip_reservations"."end_date" is null or "trip_reservations"."end_date" <> "trip_reservations"."start_date" or "trip_reservations"."start_time" is null or "trip_reservations"."end_time" is null or "trip_reservations"."end_time" >= "trip_reservations"."start_time"

trips_date_range_check.name: trips_date_range_check
trips_date_range_check.value: "trips"."ends_on" is null or "trips"."starts_on" is null or "trips"."ends_on" >= "trips"."starts_on"
